abstract:
Abstract
                  What happens to interfaces as generative AI disrupts the conditions of mediation, legibility, and control we have come to expect? This essay traces three fractures: a collapse of visibility, where interfaces obscure as much as they reveal; a collapse of form, where interfaces dissolve into language and prediction; and a collapse of positionality, where it becomes unclear who is thinking or speaking. In response, we offer five parables, five metaphors of physical transformation, from which to reconsider what interfaces might become.

ur.tldr: 生成式AI正动摇传统界面对中介、可读性与控制的支撑，使界面呈现、交互形式及“谁在思考或发声”的主体位置同时失序。文章以五个物理变形寓言为隐喻框架，重新推想生成式时代界面的可能形态。

title: Interfacing in Crisis: Five Parables for Interface Thinking
